chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: សិក្ខាអន្តរអន័យ
chunks.text: ផ្នែកទី ១.២ — អនុគមន៍សនិទានប្រភេទ y = (ax² + bx + c)/(px + q) មានសិក្ខាអន្តរ (oblique asymptote) ជាបន្ទាត់ y = (a/p)x + b' ដែលក្រាភបន្ទាត់នៃអនុគមន៍ចូលទៅជិតនៅពេល x → ±∞។ ដើម្បីរកសិក្ខាអន្តរ ត្រូវធ្វើការចែករំលែករួចហើយជ្រើសរើសផ្នែក x ជាសិក្ខាអន្តរ។
chunks.normalizedText: Section 1.2 — Rational functions of the form y = (ax²+bx+c)/(px+q) have an oblique asymptote found by polynomial long division. The oblique asymptote y = mx + b is the non-remainder part of the division. The graph approaches this line as x → ±∞.

formulas.meaning: General form of rational function with oblique asymptote
Condition for y = mx + b to be an oblique asymptote

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ការសិក្សាពេញលេញនៃអនុគមន៍សនិទាន
chunks.text: ឧទាហរណ៍ ១៖ ចូរសិក្សា និងគូរក្រាភនៃអនុគមន៍ f(x) = (x² - 5x + 7)/(x - 2)។ ដែន D = ℝ \ {2}។ ការចែករំលែក: f(x) = x - 3 + 1/(x-2)។ សិក្ខាឈរ: x = 2។ សិក្ខាអន្តរ: y = x - 3។ អាំងតេរ៉ាល់: f'(x) = 1 - 1/(x-2)² = (x²-4x+3)/(x-2)²។ f'(x) = 0 នៅ x = 1 និង x = 3។ f(1) = -3 (អតិបរមាក្នុងតំបន់) f(3) = 1 (អប្បបរមាក្នុងតំបន់)។
chunks.normalizedText: Example 1: Full study of f(x) = (x²-5x+7)/(x-2). Find domain, asymptotes (vertical x=2, oblique y=x-3 via polynomial division), derivative f'(x)=(x²-4x+3)/(x-2)², critical points at x=1 (local max f=-3) and x=3 (local min f=1), table of variation, and sketch the curve.

problem.textKh: ចូរដាក់ដែន ស្វែងរកសិក្ខា គណនាដេរីវេ រៀបចំតារាងប្រែប្រួល និងគូរក្រាភនៃអនុគមន៍ f(x) = (x² - 5x + 7)/(x - 2)
problem.text: Study and sketch the graph of the rational function f(x) = (x² - 5x + 7)/(x - 2): find domain, asymptotes, derivative, table of variation, local extrema.

solutionSteps.text: Domain: D = ℝ \ {2} since denominator is zero at x = 2
solutionSteps.explanationKh: x - 2 = 0 ⟹ x = 2 ត្រូវដកចេញពីដែន
solutionSteps.explanation: Exclude x = 2 where the denominator vanishes

solutionSteps.textKh: ចែករំលែកដើម្បីរកសិក្ខាអន្តរ: f(x) = x - 3 + 1/(x-2)
solutionSteps.text: Polynomial long division to isolate the oblique asymptote: f(x) = x - 3 + 1/(x-2)
solutionSteps.explanationKh: ការចែករំលែក: x²-5x+7 ÷ (x-2) = x-3 សល់ 1
solutionSteps.explanation: Long division: x²-5x+7 = (x-2)(x-3) + 1, so remainder is 1
As x approaches 2 from left, f → -∞; from right, f → +∞

solutionSteps.textKh: សិក្ខាអន្តរ: y = x - 3 ព្រោះ lim[f(x)-(x-3)] = lim 1/(x-2) = 0
solutionSteps.text: Oblique asymptote: y = x - 3, since f(x) - (x-3) = 1/(x-2) → 0 as x → ±∞
solutionSteps.explanationKh: ផ្នែក 1/(x-2) ចូលទៅ 0 នៅ x → ±∞ ដូច្នេះ y = x-3 ជាសិក្ខាអន្តរ
solutionSteps.explanation: The remainder term 1/(x-2) vanishes at infinity, confirming y = x-3 as the oblique asymptote
Derivative of 1/(x-2) is -1/(x-2)², combined with derivative of (x-3) which is 1

solutionSteps.text: Critical points: f'(x) = 0 when x²-4x+3 = 0, giving x = 1 and x = 3
solutionSteps.explanation: Factor or use quadratic formula: discriminant = 16-12 = 4, roots at x=1 and x=3

solutionSteps.text: Function values at critical points: f(1) = -3 (local maximum), f(3) = 1 (local minimum)
solutionSteps.explanation: f' > 0 on (-∞,1)∪(3,+∞) → increasing; f' < 0 on (1,2)∪(2,3) → decreasing; so x=1 is local max and x=3 is local min

solutionSteps.text: Graph: two asymptotes x=2 (vertical) and y=x-3 (oblique). Curve increases on (-∞,1), decreases on (1,2)∪(2,3), increases on (3,+∞). Local max at (1,-3), local min at (3,1).
solutionSteps.explanationKh: ក្រាភស្ថិតនៅលើ y=x-3 នៅ x>2 ព្រោះ 1/(x-2)>0 និងនៅក្រោម y=x-3 នៅ x<2
solutionSteps.explanation: Graph is above oblique asymptote for x>2 (since 1/(x-2)>0) and below for x<2 (since 1/(x-2)<0)

finalAnswer.textKh: ដូចនេះ អនុគមន៍ f(x) = (x²-5x+7)/(x-2) មានសិក្ខាឈរ x=2, សិក្ខាអន្តរ y=x-3, អតិបរមាក្នុងតំបន់នៅ (1,-3) និងអប្បបរមាក្នុងតំបន់នៅ (3,1)។
finalAnswer.text: f(x) = (x²-5x+7)/(x-2) has vertical asymptote x=2, oblique asymptote y=x-3, local maximum at (1,-3), local minimum at (3,1).
finalAnswer.latex: \begin{cases} \text{Vertical asymptote: } x = 2 \\ \text{Oblique asymptote: } y = x - 3 \\ \text{Local max: } (1,\,-3) \\ \text{Local min: } (3,\,1) \end{cases}

formulas.meaning: Polynomial division — key step to identify oblique asymptote
Derivative used to find monotonicity and critical points
Values at critical points (local max and local min)

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ទីតាំងក្រាភធៀបនឹងសិក្ខាអន្តរ
chunks.text: ក្រាភស្ថិតនៅលើ ឬក្រោម សិក្ខាអន្តរ អាស្រ័យលើសញ្ញានៃផ្នែកដែលនៅសល់ (remainder)។ សម្រាប់ f(x) = x-3 + 1/(x-2): នៅ x>2, 1/(x-2)>0 ដូច្នេះ f(x)>x-3 (ក្រាភនៅលើសិក្ខាអន្តរ)។ នៅ x<2, 1/(x-2)<0 ដូច្នេះ f(x)<x-3 (ក្រាភនៅក្រោមសិក្ខាអន្តរ)។
chunks.normalizedText: The graph of a rational function lies above or below its oblique asymptote depending on the sign of the remainder term. For f(x) = x-3 + 1/(x-2): above y=x-3 when x>2 (remainder positive), below y=x-3 when x<2 (remainder negative). This determines which side of the asymptote the curve approaches from.

formulas.meaning: Sign of remainder determines position relative to oblique asymptote
